description.zh: 通道账户ID，不传时默认为default
description.en: The account ID for the channel. If omitted, the default value is 'default'.

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
本API用于将PolarClaw（通过`ApplicationId`标识）的 Agent（由`AgentId`指定）与给定的通信渠道（`Channel`）进行关联。如果需要，还可以指定该渠道内的账户ID（`ChannelAccountId`）。
descriptions.en:
## Request

This API associates an agent from a PolarClaw application with a communication channel. You specify the application with `ApplicationId`, the agent with `AgentId`, and the channel with `Channel`. You can optionally specify an account ID for the channel with `ChannelAccountId`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb bind-polar-claw-agent --application-id pa-00000000000000 --agent-id work --channel feishu --channel-account-id default --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb BindPolarClawAgent --region cn-hangzhou --Channel feishu --ChannelAccountId default --AgentId work --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000'
